portfolio.1.title: Muffin Time 吸爆鬆餅
portfolio.1.text:
Muffin Time is a chaotic card game with more twists and turns than you can shake a spork at! Battle your friends, family, and hyper-intelligent pets by drawing and playing from a deck of unique cards that'll either help you, thwart others, or mix things up for the sheer hell of it! To win the game, you just need to start your turn with exactly 10 cards in your hand but if you think that'll be easy, you're wrong (wronger than a duck wearing shoes- and that's pretty damn wrong).

這款派對遊戲的美術是由Thomas Ridgewell操刀，也就是無厘頭到備受讚譽的「asdfmovie」作者，在原系列短片中那不可預期的隨機性，與懷疑作者該去看醫生的超展開都化作遊戲卡牌忠實呈現！遊戲的卡牌分為「藍色」行動卡、「綠色」反擊卡和「紅色」陷阱卡，卡上的能力都圍繞著拿取卡牌或令其他玩家棄掉手牌，玩家需要善用卡牌在一團混戰中取得剛好10張手牌來獲得最終勝利。

Whether you're looking to expand your game into new markets, localize it for different audiences, or transform it into an exciting digital experience, we’ve got you covered. about.mission.title: Our Mission
about.mission.text: Great games deserve players everywhere. We help publishers and designers bring their board games to Asia — and bring Asian games to the world — with care for every card, rulebook and box.
about.name.title: Why "Unizza"?
about.name.text: Our name combines the prefix of unique “uni-” with “-zza” from pizza — a playful image of the  gaming world. The name also subtly reflects our Unity-based development origins. As we evolved to focus more on publishing, localization, and game licensing. Unizza Games became the perfect identity to capture our expanded vision.

videogames.title: Video Game Services
videogames.subtitle: From tabletop to screen. We build the digital side of your board game — before, during and after launch.
videogames.1.title: Companion App Development
videogames.1.text: A companion app that makes your board game easier to learn and more fun to play. We design and build it around your rules and your art, so it feels like part of the box — not an add-on.
videogames.1.point.1: Interactive rules, tutorials and setup guides
videogames.1.point.2: Scoring, timers, narration and hidden-information helpers
videogames.1.point.3: iOS, Android and web, with multi-language support
videogames.2.title: Video Game Adaptation
videogames.2.text: We turn your board game into a full video game for PC, mobile or console — keeping the rules and feel your players love, and adding what only a screen can do.
videogames.2.point.1: Faithful rules engine and AI opponents
videogames.2.point.3: Store launch on Steam, the App Store and Google Play
videogames.3.title: Early-Release Demo App
videogames.3.text: A playable digital demo that lets players try your game before it’s printed. Use it to win backers on Kickstarter, run remote playtests, and show your game at conventions.
videogames.3.point.1: A focused, playable build of your core gameplay
videogames.3.point.3: Ready for crowdfunding pages, press and events
